task.title: Reassignment verifiers must search live+archived activity-log sources, not just LOG_FILE

scope.owned_layer: How the reassignment gates in scripts/ai_status.py read the activity audit: the source set they search, not the rules they apply to what they find.
scope.not_changing: .orchestrator/supervisor.py and the task_reassigned emitter, activity rotation itself, activity_audit_source_paths_unlocked in .orchestrator/common.py, and every ordering / self-consistency / authenticity rule in _walk_audited_role_chain. Error messages are unchanged.

problem.summary: The reassignment verifiers read only LOG_FILE -- the live activity-log tail -- when looking for the audited task_reassigned event that justifies an owner or reviewer drift. Rotation moves the oldest lines out of that tail into an immutable gzip archive once the log exceeds LOG_ROTATE_MAX_BYTES, which under normal fleet write volume happens within hours. A legitimate, audited reassignment therefore becomes invisible to the gate purely because time passed.
problem.production_incident: SUP-TASK-FAILURE-STREAK-SCHEMA-20260804 was permanently stuck at `done`: its task_reassigned event was real and audited, but rotation had already moved it into archive/logs/*.gz before closeout ran, and the LOG_FILE-only read had no fallback.
problem.why_it_is_not_an_edge_case: Rotation is routine, not exceptional. Every reassigned task that does not close out inside one rotation window hits this.

change._activity_events_across_sources: New helper. Walks the same disjoint, ordered, validated live+archive source list activity_audit_source_paths_unlocked already produces, transparently gunzipping .gz sources, and yields activity event dicts oldest-first (the same order a top-to-bottom LOG_FILE read produced). Rotation lineage-head control rows are skipped -- they are not activity events. JSON parsing stays strict: an unparsable line raises, matching every other reader of these canonical sources, so a tampered line cannot silently drop a hop out of a chain.
change._audited_reassignment_events: Now sources its events from _activity_events_across_sources(LOG_FILE) instead of read_regular_file_bytes(LOG_FILE). FileNotFoundError and archive-integrity RuntimeError are converted to the caller's existing unavailable_message, so the fail-closed contract is unchanged. Nothing else about the function moved: the same Orchestrator-actor / digest-authenticity filter runs, and the result is still sorted oldest-first.
change.blast_radius: Because `dev` had already funnelled every gate through _audited_reassignment_events, this single change fixes all four call sites at once -- reconcile owner (_verified_owner_reassignment), reconcile reviewer (_verified_reviewer_reassignment), done owner (_verified_done_owner_reassignment) and done reviewer (_verified_done_reviewer_reassignment). No caller reads LOG_FILE for reassignment audit any more.

merge_resolution.context: This task branch was opened before `dev` merged PR #4577 (OPS-CLOSEOUT-OWNER-REASSIGN-NO-HUMAN-SIGNOFF-20260805), which refactored the two verifiers into the shared _audited_reassignment_events / _walk_audited_role_chain helpers. Both sides had independently de-duplicated the same code, so the merge conflicted.
merge_resolution.resolution: `dev`'s structure was kept wholesale and the archive fallback was re-applied at the one place that now reads the audit. The task's own duplicate refactor was discarded as redundant. Both regression tests were kept and rebuilt on `dev`'s audited_reassignment_event fixture so their event_id carries the supervisor digest the tightened gate requires.
merge_commits: 90b51942d -- fold the stale-base pushed task commit into the dev-based branch without a force-push
b1e594dc9 -- merge dev, resolving scripts/ai_status.py and scripts/test_ai_status.py

acceptance.finds_event_after_rotation: PASS -- test_reviewer_reassignment_found_after_rotation_into_archive and test_prior_owner_reassignment_found_after_rotation_into_archive each force a real rotation via ai_status.maybe_rotate_activity_log() with LOG_ROTATE_MAX_BYTES=1, assert the event_id is genuinely gone from the live tail, and then assert the verifier still resolves it out of the archive.
acceptance.shared_helper_not_per_call_site_reads: PASS -- `grep -n 'read_regular_file_bytes(LOG_FILE' scripts/ai_status.py` returns nothing in the reassignment gates; all four gates reach the audit through _audited_reassignment_events, which reaches the sources through _activity_events_across_sources.
acceptance.semantics_unchanged: PASS -- ordering (oldest-first, then sorted by timestamp), the digest authenticity filter, the chain-continuity rules, and every SystemExit message are untouched. The full suite, including every pre-existing negative test for forged, tampered, stale, out-of-order and disconnected audits, passes unmodified.
acceptance.fails_on_pre_fix_code: PASS -- with _audited_reassignment_events reverted to the LOG_FILE-only read, both rotation regressions fail with the exact production messages: `Cannot reconcile task: merged evidence does not bind the canonical reviewer metadata and no exact task_reassigned audit event chain explains the drift.` and `Cannot finalize task: prior-owner LLM-Agent trailer requires an exact audited supervisor task_reassigned event.`

Confirm widening the source set cannot admit an event the old code would have rejected: the Orchestrator-actor and event_id digest filters still run on every archived event.
